Title: Two questions about Seeds of Corruption

Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
1). Does SoC removes the vampire's title or not? Unofficial FAQ says
it does, but some threads in this newsgroup state it doesn't.
Currently I think that the card doesn't strip *Titles* and doesn't
prohibit voting, but it *does* prohibit using any cards or abilities
that require the title. For instance, Prince with Seeds still has two
votes, but he cannot play Parity Shift, Second Tradition etc. Am I
right?
2). An action to remove Seeds on my vampire is not directed (D) if my
minion is acting, but it will be directed (D) if the acting minion is
controlled by another player, right?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Ector" <Ec...@mail.ru> wrote in message
news:d6c82c73.04092...@posting.google.com...

> 1). Does SoC removes the vampire's title or not? Unofficial FAQ says
> it does, but some threads in this newsgroup state it doesn't.

When the official and the unofficial are at odds, take the official.

"Special ability" includes all non-term (Clan, Sect, Title, Unique (or
not), Blood Cursed, Circle, Flight, Infernal, Scarce, Slave, Sterile,
Vulnerability, Anarch, Black Hand, Seraph) text. (note that this only
restricts things that are possible only by special ability - things that a
special ability makes impossible are still impossible.) [LSJ 19970801] [LSJ
20011211] [LSJ 20040120] [RTR 20040501]

> Currently I think that the card doesn't strip *Titles* and doesn't
> prohibit voting, but it *does* prohibit using any cards or abilities
> that require the title. For instance, Prince with Seeds still has two
> votes, but he cannot play Parity Shift, Second Tradition etc. Am I
> right?

No. The prince can vote, play Parity Shift, play Second Tradition, etc.

> 2). An action to remove Seeds on my vampire is not directed (D) if my
> minion is acting, but it will be directed (D) if the acting minion is
> controlled by another player, right?

Yes.

>>"Special ability" includes all non-term (Clan, Sect, Title, Unique
(or
>>not), Blood Cursed, Circle, Flight, Infernal, Scarce, Slave,
Sterile,
>>Vulnerability, Anarch, Black Hand, Seraph) text.

Oh, Dear!!!
I finally understood the statement. It means that "special ability"
DOESN'T include TERM TEXT, like Clan, Sect or Title.
Sorry for misunderstanding, but English isn't my native language, and
this statement is the most confusing I've ever read :) I'd appreciate
this variant:

"Special ability" doesn't include any "term text" (Clan, Sect, Title,

Unique (or
not), Blood Cursed, Circle, Flight, Infernal, Scarce, Slave, Sterile,

Vulnerability, Anarch, Black Hand, Seraph), but includes any other
text.

All players I know just didn't pay attention to the negation in the
built-in "definition word" "NON-TERM". Thanks for your help, anyway.
